purpose: Store the user-confirmed functional semantics, constrained logical parameter ranges, and acceptance gates for the next S5-S9 scenario revision without retroactively changing the frozen scenario contract or the dataset used by the ongoing Stage1-A training run.

latest_revision.summary: Revise S5 so its fixed five-seed evaluation must contain physically realized maneuver diversity, including at least one lane-change episode and at least one non-synchronous platoon response; permit reassembly on any scenario-valid lane. Retain the strengthened S6-S9 interaction, asynchronous-maneuver, and reassembly definitions.

compatibility.ongoing_training_policy: Do not stop or modify the ongoing training run. It remains bound to the current frozen scenario contract and formal 50k dataset.
compatibility.non_retroactivity: This candidate memory does not relabel, overwrite, or invalidate metadata on the current formal 50k dataset or checkpoints trained from it.
compatibility.no_mixing: Artifacts generated after implementing this candidate design must use a new scenario contract identifier and must not be mixed with the current formal 50k root.
activation_gates: implement scenarios sequentially in order S5, S6, S7, S8, S9 outside the active training execution boundary
run focused topology, actor-realization, conflict-realization, expert-action, and safety tests for each scenario
run a fixed five-seed top-down video review after each scenario implementation
require every declared actor and recipe to be realized with no silent actor loss
freeze a new scenario contract hash only after all five functional acceptance gates pass
collect a new exact-path pilot before considering any new formal dataset collection

required_conflict_evidence: all declared actors spawned and remained addressable by role
actor lane transition or longitudinal conflict event occurred as defined by the scenario
conflict-point arrival-time difference was inside the scenario range
minimum TTC and gap were measured against the designated conflict actor
the expected ego route transition or avoidance maneuver was completed
formation_transition_evidence: formation release must be physically observable through different ego lane or route-segment occupancy, a cut-in actor occupying an internal platoon gap, or a measured loss of the configured longitudinal formation gaps
asynchronous maneuver claims require recorded physical transition times and at least one state where the three ego vehicles have not all completed the same route transition
formation reassembly requires all three ego vehicles on one scenario-valid lane, preserved platoon order, recovered configured longitudinal gaps, and persistence for the configured validation window
behavior commands without matching lane, route, gap, and trajectory evidence do not satisfy functional acceptance

S5_hard_brake_lead.functional_name: hard-braking lead with randomized adjacent-lane constraints
S5_hard_brake_lead.functional_intent: A three-car platoon approaches a lead vehicle that brakes sharply. Randomized adjacent-lane constraints must produce diverse hard-safe responses across the fixed five-seed evaluation, including braking and physically realized lane-change or temporary formation-release behavior. After the hazard, the platoon may reassemble on any scenario-valid lane.
fixed_semantics: one controllable lead actor brakes after a finite approach period
one actor is placed on each existing adjacent lane when the map exposes both sides
the mapping from lane side to ahead/behind relation is not fixed
there are no discrete left-open, right-open, or both-blocked scenario variants
RuleMaker profiles are evaluated separately and are not silently mixed in one dataset
sampling_constraints: both adjacent actors must spawn on real adjacent lanes; adjacent_lane_missing is a hard failure
ahead/behind relations are sampled without fixing a permanent relation to left or right
the trigger state must contain KEEP plus at least one other hard-safe joint action for RuleMaker profile comparison
the hard-braking lead remains the causal hazard regardless of adjacent-actor samples
accepted_behaviors: coordinated lane change into a hard-safe adjacent gap
asynchronous or mixed-direction lane changes that temporarily release formation
formation reassembly on any scenario-valid common lane with preserved platoon order and recovered longitudinal gaps

five_seed_behavior_diversity.evidence: behavior classes and lane changes must be derived from physical lane IDs, lane-transition completion times, and trajectories rather than RuleMaker commands

acceptance_gates: lead actor realizes the sampled deceleration profile
both adjacent actors realize their sampled roles
at least two RuleMaker profiles select different safe behavior classes on part of the shared concrete test set
the fixed five-seed result contains at least two physically realized behavior classes and at least one episode with a real lane change
at least one of the five seeds contains a non-synchronous platoon response; five all-KEEP episodes or five synchronous same-direction lane-change episodes fail acceptance
the platoon avoids collision and road exit
formation recovery is measured after the hazard clears
temporary formation release is credited only when physical lane IDs and transition times prove the claimed split behavior
reassembly succeeds on any scenario-valid common lane when all three vehicles recover platoon order and longitudinal formation gaps; return to the initial middle lane is not required

candidate_revision_evidence_20260812.artifact_note: Diagnostic closed-loop run intentionally disabled top-down video, semantic-BEV video, and trajectory NPZ; this path is evidence for machine gates only and is not a video-review deliverable.

S6_background_merge_in.functional_name: background actor merges into either platoon gap
S6_background_merge_in.functional_intent: A controlled ramp actor cuts into either internal platoon gap. After the realized cut-in, the ego vehicles must respond with hard-safe KEEP, LEFT, or RIGHT behavior, temporarily release formation when required, and finally reassemble on one common lane without collision.
sampling_constraints: spawn longitude is solved from the sampled conflict-point arrival time instead of sampled independently
both target gaps receive balanced coverage across an evaluation or collection manifest
the merge actor must cross into the platoon mainline and occupy the designated target-gap corridor
a natural non-interacting pass outside the target gap is invalid
the cut-in must causally trigger a measurable ego speed, gap, or lane response
accepted_behaviors: KEEP lane while yielding and expanding the designated gap
hard-safe LEFT lane change after the cut-in
hard-safe RIGHT lane change after the cut-in
temporary formation release followed by reassembly on one common lane
acceptance_gates: merge actor completes its lane transition
merge actor physically occupies the designated agent0-agent1 or agent1-agent2 corridor as a realized cut-in
arrival-time delta and TTC are inside their sampled ranges
physical lane IDs and trajectories prove any claimed LEFT or RIGHT lane change; a command alone is insufficient
the platoon exhibits a measurable KEEP, LEFT, or RIGHT response after the cut-in
all three ego vehicles later occupy one common lane in platoon order with recovered longitudinal gaps
the cut-in, response, and reassembly complete without collision, road exit, or planner fallback

S7_ego_merge_from_ramp.functional_name: three-car platoon negotiates a timed mainline gap
S7_ego_merge_from_ramp.functional_intent: The three-car platoon enters from a ramp under a controlled stream of critical front and rear actors. The platoon must temporarily dissolve and merge asynchronously rather than perform one synchronized lane change, then reassemble on one mainline lane.

severity_semantics.low: a wide gap permits direct accelerated merge
severity_semantics.medium: the platoon must adjust speed or formation before merging
severity_semantics.high: the platoon must yield for a critical rear actor and use the next valid gap

sampling_constraints: all declared actors must spawn successfully before the episode is eligible
critical actor positions are solved from conflict-point arrival times
far actors that do not affect a merge opportunity do not count toward scenario density
at least one valid full-platoon merge opportunity must exist
the sampled traffic timing must create a safe asynchronous merge solution for the three ego vehicles
acceptance_gates: all three ego vehicles leave the ramp and enter the mainline
critical front and rear actors traverse the merge conflict region
the test set covers both pass-first and yield-then-merge behavior
a physical split state is observed in which at least one ego vehicle is already on the mainline while at least one other ego vehicle remains on the ramp
the three lane-transition completion events are not all simultaneous
no ego vehicle remains stranded on the ramp
after merging, all three ego vehicles occupy one common mainline lane in platoon order with recovered longitudinal gaps
the asynchronous merge and reassembly complete without collision, road exit, or planner fallback

S8_ego_exit_to_ramp.functional_name: three-car platoon follows a continuous mainline-to-ramp route
S8_ego_exit_to_ramp.functional_intent: The platoon starts from the middle mainline lane and must interact with one to three actors on the right exit-side lane. The interaction temporarily dissolves the platoon and produces asynchronous moves into the rightmost lane before all three vehicles enter the exit ramp, continue with KEEP, and reassemble by longitudinal gap adjustment.
development_stages: prove the complete route chain with zero background actors
prove the expected KEEP-RIGHT-KEEP action transition for all three agents
then enable one to three constrained exit-lane actors and require the full interaction, asynchronous lane-change, and reassembly semantics
expected_action_sequence: interact with at least one right-lane actor through measurable speed, gap, or lane-change timing adjustment
temporarily release formation and complete non-simultaneous RIGHT lane changes into the exit-side lane
KEEP while continuing along the ramp
recover longitudinal platoon gaps on the ramp
acceptance_gates: the road graph exposes every edge in the required route chain
one to three declared right-lane trigger actors spawn and remain addressable by role
at least one trigger actor has a causal interaction with the ego platoon; incidental coexistence is insufficient
a physical split state and distinct lane-transition completion times prove that the three ego vehicles did not change to the rightmost lane simultaneously
all three agents traverse the diverge connector
all three agents enter and continue along the exit ramp
all three ego vehicles reassemble in platoon order on the ramp through longitudinal gap recovery
repeated RIGHT after entering the connector is forbidden
remaining on the through mainline at the horizon is failure even without a collision
the interaction, exit, and reassembly complete without collision, road exit, or planner fallback

S9_narrow_channel_negotiation.functional_name: mandatory coordinated bypass of a slow or stopped blocker
S9_narrow_channel_negotiation.functional_intent: The ego platoon starts in the middle lane behind a slow or stopped blocker, while one to three trigger actors constrain the left bypass lane. The platoon must temporarily dissolve, negotiate individual safe opportunities to move LEFT into the only topology-valid bypass lane, pass the blocker, continue along the narrow road, and reassemble without returning to the original lane.
sampling_constraints: the blocker must occupy the ego route lane and make KEEP-only progress invalid
one to three trigger actors on the left bypass lane must create a real but hard-safe temporal constraint
the bypass direction is fixed to LEFT by topology rather than randomized
the full three-car platoon must have a feasible asynchronous bypass solution
trigger actors must cause measurable ego speed, gap, or lane-change timing adjustment; incidental coexistence is insufficient
expected_action_sequence: KEEP or controlled deceleration while approaching
temporarily release formation and negotiate non-simultaneous LEFT lane changes into the bypass lane
KEEP and continue along the narrow road in the bypass lane
recover platoon formation without returning to the original lane
acceptance_gates: the middle-lane blocker and all one to three declared left-lane trigger actors realize their roles
at least one left-lane trigger actor has a causal interaction with the ego platoon
all three ego vehicles complete a real lane transition before reaching the blocker
physical lane IDs prove LEFT transitions from c3 lane 1 to lane 0, and distinct completion times prove temporary formation dissolution
all three ego vehicles pass the blocker longitudinally
all three continue on the narrow road after the bypass
all-KEEP, stop-until-horizon, or return-to-original-lane outcomes are not successful
all three ego vehicles recover platoon order and longitudinal gaps on the narrow road without returning to lane 1
the bypass and reassembly complete without collision, road exit, or planner fallback
